title: polypodium hemionitideum
intro: Polypodium hemionitideum, commonly known as Autumn Gold Polypody, is a species of fern native to the Himalayas and parts of Asia. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been found to have several health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function, due to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of Autumn Gold Polypody include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
